heading: top-split
name: 左右分開標題＋方形圖片卡片輪播（箭頭疊在圖片上）
desc: 上方標題靠左、文字連結靠右；下方是一次露出約四個項目、最後一個被內容寬度右緣裁切的輪播，左右圓形箭頭疊在圖片高度的中間。每個項目是方形圖片、一排小縮圖與文字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方放標題組：標題靠左，文字連結靠右，兩者在同一列；標題組包含標題（可多行），右側的文字連結可省略。標題組下方是輪播，左緣對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機一次露出約四個等寬項目，最後一個項目被頁面內容寬度的右緣裁切、只露出一部分，不延伸到畫面邊緣。左右各有一顆較大的圓形箭頭圖示按鈕（明顯大於圖片上的圖示按鈕，但遠小於圖片），疊在輪播上、垂直位置在項目圖片高度的中間：左箭頭壓在第一個項目的左緣、略為超出，右箭頭疊在最後露出的項目右側；在第一個項目時左箭頭呈停用狀態，到最後一個項目時停住、不循環，不自動播放。每個項目無外框：上方是一張方形圖片，所有項目同一比例，圖片左上角可疊一個小圖示，右上角疊一顆圖示按鈕，沒有時省略；圖片下方是一排小方形縮圖，目前選取的縮圖有外框，縮圖列下方有一條分隔線；接著是標題（可多行），下方是說明文字與一段次要文字，沒有時省略。圖片下方的縮圖列和文字比圖片左緣內縮。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數量減少。
mobile: 輪播改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一個項目，約佔畫面寬的六成並靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣。左右箭頭按鈕隱藏，改用手指左右滑動切換。標題組維持同一列，標題靠左、文字連結靠右。項目內的組成不變。

en.name: Split heading + square image card carousel (arrows over the images)
en.desc: A title on the left and a text link on the right at the top; below is a carousel showing about four items at a time, the last one cropped by the right edge of the page content width, with round left and right arrows over the middle of the image height. Each item is a square image, a row of small thumbnails and text.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, with the title on the left and a text link on the right, both on the same row; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), and the text link on the right is optional. Below the heading group is a carousel whose left edge aligns with the page content width; on desktop it shows about four equal-width items at a time, and the last item is cropped by the right edge of the page content width so only part of it shows, without extending to the screen edge. There is a large round arrow icon button on each side (noticeably larger than the icon button over the image, but much smaller than the image), laid over the carousel and positioned vertically at the middle of the item image height: the left arrow overlaps the left edge of the first item, sticking out slightly, and the right arrow sits over the right side of the last visible item. At the first item the left arrow is shown as disabled; at the last item the carousel stops rather than looping, and it does not autoplay. Each item has no border: at the top is a square image, the same ratio for all items, optionally with a small icon over its top-left corner and an icon button over its top-right corner; omit them when there is no content. Below the image is a row of small square thumbnails, with the currently selected thumbnail outlined and a divider below the thumbnail row; then a title (may wrap to multiple lines), followed by a description and a line of secondary text; omit them when there is no content. The thumbnail row and the text below the image are inset from the left edge of the image.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one item is visible at a time, taking about sixty percent of the screen width and aligned left with the page content width, while part of the next item shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. The left and right arrow buttons are hidden, and items are switched by swiping left and right. The heading group stays on one row, with the title on the left and the text link on the right. The composition of each item stays the same.
